ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: The figure is a circle, and the four vertices of quadrilateral ABCD are all on the circle. The order of the points along the circumference can be read as A-B-C-D. A is at the lower left, B is at the upper left, C is at the upper right, D is at the lower right, Z is marked inside the circle as the center of the circle, and ZA and ZB are connected, so ∠BZA is a central angle. Reasoning: According to the problem statement, m∠BZA = 104°, and a central angle is equal to the measure of its intercepted minor arc, so m arc AB = 104°. It is also given that m arc CB = 94°. The requested m arc ADC is the arc from A to C that passes through D, which is the remaining part of the whole circle that does not include arc AB and arc BC. Therefore m arc ADC = 360° - 104° - 94° = 162°.

raw_record.question_text: Quadrilateral $ABCD$ is inscribed in $\odot Z$ such that $m\angle BZA = 104$, $m\widehat{CB} = 94$, and $\overline{AB} \parallel \overline{DC}$. Find $m\widehat{ADC}$.

method.method_draft: Read the diagram as a cyclic quadrilateral with the points arranged around the circle in order A-B-C-D, so the requested arc ADC is the arc from A to C going through D, i.e. the complement of arcs AB and BC. From the text, angle BZA is a central angle of circle Z, so its measure 104 equals the measure of minor arc BA. Also use the given m arc CB = 94. Then compute m arc ADC = 360 - m arc AB - m arc BC = 360 - 104 - 94 = 162.
method.CoT_raw: 图像描述：图中是一个圆，四边形 ABCD 的四个顶点都在圆上，点的顺序沿圆周可读为 A-B-C-D。A 在左下方，B 在左上方，C 在右上方，D 在右下方，Z 标在圆内作为圆心，连有 ZA 和 ZB，因此 ∠BZA 是圆心角。推理：根据题意，m∠BZA = 104°，圆心角等于其所对小弧的度数，所以 m弧AB = 104°。又给出 m弧CB = 94°。所求 m弧ADC 是从 A 到 C 且经过 D 的弧，也就是整圆中不包含弧AB和弧BC的剩余部分。因此 m弧ADC = 360° - 104° - 94° = 162°。

method.method_draft: Use the parallel-chord information. From the image, AB and DC are opposite chords of the cyclic quadrilateral, and the text states AB is parallel to DC. First convert the central angle m angle BZA = 104 to arc AB = 104. Given arc CB = 94. Because AB is parallel to DC, the arcs cut off between the parallel chords on the same side are congruent, so arc AD = arc BC = 94. Then use the full circle sum to find arc CD = 360 - arc AB - arc BC - arc AD = 360 - 104 - 94 - 94 = 68. Finally, arc ADC = arc AD + arc DC = 94 + 68 = 162.
